说明 README: 老师改这个文件就能更新每周内容。weekly = 每周一帖（start 是上线日期，到这一天才会出现）；challenges = 真实挑战；classBest = 本周最佳评论（不用就写 null）；submitUrl = 学生交截图的问卷链接（不用就留空）。最下面的 _template 是空白模板，复制一份放进 weekly 里再填。

weekly.src: 铁蛋「我的新形象有没有很惊艳」评论区
weekly.src_en: From the comments on Tyler's video
weekly.text: 为啥染了黑头发显得更年轻了呢[表情]
weekly.en: How come dyeing his hair black makes him look younger? [sticker]

q.zh: 这位网友觉得铁蛋染了黑头发以后怎么样？
q.en: What does this user think of Tyler after he dyed his hair black?

task.zh: 学这位网友，用「为啥……呢」给铁蛋写一条评论，问一个你好奇的问题。
task.en: Like this user, write a comment to Tyler with 「为啥……呢」, asking something you are curious about.
task.hint: 为啥你的孩子一眼就认出你了呢？

weekly.src: 铁蛋「我的新形象有没有很惊艳」评论区
weekly.src_en: From the comments on Tyler's video
weekly.text: 铁蛋还是黑头发显得你高级，有点像费翔[表情]
weekly.en: Tyler, black hair really makes you look classy — you look a bit like Fei Xiang [emoji]

q.zh: 这位网友觉得铁蛋像谁？
q.en: Who does this user think Tyler looks like?

task.zh: 用「有点像……」写一条评论：你觉得染发以后的铁蛋像谁？

task.hint: 铁蛋染了头发以后有点像……

challenges.zh: 在小红书上关注一位中国博主，看完他最新的一条笔记。
challenges.en: Follow a Chinese creator on Xiaohongshu and read their latest note.

challenges.zh: 给一条你喜欢的笔记点赞、收藏，再留一条中文评论。
challenges.en: Like and save a note you enjoy, then leave a comment in Chinese.

challenges.zh: 在小红书搜「挑战」，找一条挑战类视频，说说它有哪几个阶段。
challenges.en: Search 「挑战」 on Xiaohongshu, find a challenge video and name its stages.

challenges.zh: 在一条真实的笔记下面，用「挺……的」或「更……了」写一条评论。
challenges.en: Under a real note, write a comment using 「挺……的」 or 「更……了」.

videos.title: 示例：这里写视频标题
videos.creator: 博主名字
videos.intro: 一句话介绍这条视频：谁、挑战什么。
videos.intro_en: One line about the video: who, and what the challenge is.

lines.zh: 今天我挑战一天只说中文。
lines.en: Today I'm challenging myself to speak only Chinese for a day.

lines.zh: 你们觉得我能坚持到晚上吗？
lines.en: Do you think I can last until tonight?

patterns.note: 用问题结尾，邀请观众评论。
patterns.note_en: End with a question to invite comments.
patterns.ex: 你们觉得我能坚持到晚上吗？
patterns.ex_en: Do you think I can last until tonight?

questions.zh: 他挑战的是什么？
questions.en: What is the challenge?
opts: Speak only Chinese for a day
questions.why: 开头就说清楚了挑战是什么，这是「挑战设定」。
questions.why_en: He states the challenge at the start: that's the Challenge stage.

questions.zh: 和铁蛋的视频比，哪里不一样？
questions.en: How is it different from Tyler's video?
opts: 没有「引出话题」，直接开始挑战
No premise; it starts with the challenge
questions.why: 阶段可以省略：这条视频直接从挑战开始。
questions.why_en: Stages can be skipped: this one starts right at the challenge.

videos.title: 一周只嗦粉，外国人受得了吗？
videos.creator: 庐可思议
videos.intro: 比利时博主住在广西，挑战一个星期只嗦粉，每天吃一种广西的粉，再给它打个分。
videos.intro_en: A Belgian creator living in Guangxi challenges himself to eat only rice noodles for a week: a different Guangxi noodle each day, each with a score.
videos.think: 看的时候想一想：每一天都做了什么？他是怎么告诉观众「好不好吃」的？
videos.think_en: While you watch, think: what happens each day? How does he tell viewers whether it tastes good?

lines.zh: 挑战一个星期，只能嗦粉。
lines.en: Challenge: for one week, I can only slurp rice noodles.
lines.acte: “嗦粉” in a yellow caption, said with stress

lines.zh: 因为定居广西，就得嗦粉。
lines.en: Because I’ve settled in Guangxi, I have to slurp rice noodles.

lines.zh: 我还没有掌握嗦粉的精髓。
lines.en: I haven’t mastered the essence of slurping noodles yet.
lines.act: 画面：博主和表弟在嗦粉
lines.acte: On screen: he and his cousin slurping noodles

lines.zh: 我加油尝尝各种各样的粉。
lines.en: I’ll do my best to taste all kinds of noodles.

lines.zh: 第一天，卷筒粉。
lines.en: Day one: rolled rice noodles.
lines.act: 右上角出现花字「DAY 1 卷筒粉」
lines.acte: On-screen text “DAY 1 卷筒粉” appears in the top corner

lines.zh: 一天吃三顿可以吧？
lines.en: Eating it three meals a day is fine, right?

lines.zh: 反正你不见腻，你就可以吃三顿的。
lines.en: As long as you don’t get sick of it, you can eat it three times a day.
lines.acte: The stall owner’s words are in a blue caption

lines.zh: 这个东西算嗦吗？
lines.en: Does this count as slurping?

lines.zh: 嗦粉失败。
lines.en: Slurping failed.
lines.acte: Pink caption; the friend is not on camera

lines.zh: 很好吃。
lines.en: Very tasty.
lines.act: 花字「9/10」，很多「很好吃」跳出来
lines.acte: On-screen text “9/10”, and many “很好吃” pop up

lines.zh: 第二天，生榨粉。我这是第一次吃，听说特别酸。
lines.en: Day two: fresh-pressed rice noodles. It’s my first time eating it. I heard it’s especially sour.
lines.act: 右上角出现花字「DAY 2 生榨粉」
lines.acte: On-screen text “DAY 2 生榨粉” in the top corner

lines.zh: 酸的窝，你吃过吗？
lines.en: It’s sour, you know. Have you had it?
lines.acte: Blue caption

lines.zh: 就是那个味道，那种发酵的味道。
lines.en: It’s that smell, that fermented smell.
lines.acte: Visual effect: his face turns green

lines.zh: 有一点酸的，但是我特别能接受。
lines.en: It’s a bit sour, but I can totally accept it.
lines.acte: On-screen text “7/10”

lines.zh: 哇，好辣！这是微辣吗？
lines.en: Wow, so spicy! Is this “mildly spicy”?
lines.act: 第三天，老友粉。特效：脸变红，耳朵冒烟
lines.acte: Day three: laoyou noodles. Visual effect: face turns red, ears smoke

lines.zh: 酸笋在你最讨厌的排行榜排第几啊？
lines.en: Where do pickled bamboo shoots rank on your most-hated list?
lines.acte: He asks his wife

lines.zh: 第一。
lines.en: Number one.
lines.act: 举起一根手指，粉色字幕
lines.acte: She holds up one finger; pink caption

lines.zh: 没有生榨粉好吃，但是还可以。
lines.en: It’s not as tasty as the fresh-pressed noodles, but it’s okay.
lines.acte: On-screen text “5/10”

lines.zh: 听说第一口怀疑人生，第二口有点意思，然后第三口就是完了，上瘾了。
lines.en: I heard the first bite makes you question life, the second bite is kind of interesting, and then by the third bite it’s over: you’re hooked.
lines.acte: Day four: luosifen

lines.zh: 但是我才不信，自己体验一下再说。
lines.en: But I don’t believe it. I’ll try it myself first.

lines.zh: 一点都不臭啊！
lines.en: It doesn’t stink at all!

lines.zh: 臭什么？？
lines.en: Stink? What stink?
lines.act: 蓝色字幕；后面的顾客也在笑
lines.acte: Blue caption; customers behind are laughing too

lines.zh: 螺蛳粉的味道我能给8.5/10。
lines.en: I can give the taste of luosifen 8.5 out of 10.
lines.acte: He gives a thumbs-up

lines.zh: 但是，有一说一啊，我刚才上厕所了。
lines.en: But, to be honest, I just went to the toilet.

lines.zh: 广西人喝汤是不需要勺子的。
lines.en: Guangxi people don’t need a spoon to drink soup.
lines.acte: Day five: mutton noodles

lines.zh: 我无论是嗦粉还是吃面，越宽我就越喜欢。
lines.en: Whether I’m slurping rice noodles or eating wheat noodles, the wider they are, the more I like them.
lines.acte: Day six: dried-beef noodles

lines.zh: 唯一的缺点就是这个牛巴，嗦两分钟，剔两个小时牙。
lines.en: The only drawback is this dried beef: two minutes of slurping, two hours of picking your teeth.
lines.act: 特效：嘴拉宽，额头上一大滴汗
lines.acte: Visual effect: mouth stretched wide, a big drop of sweat

lines.zh: 这几天我真的感觉我可以继续吃米粉，因为根本就吃不腻。
lines.en: These days I really feel I could keep eating rice noodles, because I just don’t get sick of them.
lines.act: 画面：回顾这几天吃粉的样子
lines.acte: On screen: a look back at the week

lines.zh: 还有很多很多粉，下周再见！
lines.en: There are still lots and lots of noodles. See you next week!

lines.zh: 关注我！
lines.en: Follow me!
lines.act: 屏幕上出现「点赞、关注、评论」
lines.acte: “Like, follow, comment” appears on screen

words: 挑战一个星期，只能嗦粉。
Challenge: for one week, I can only slurp rice noodles.
因为定居广西，就得嗦粉。
Because I’ve settled in Guangxi, I have to slurp rice noodles.
我还没有掌握嗦粉的精髓。
I haven’t mastered the essence of slurping noodles yet.
我加油尝尝各种各样的粉。
I’ll do my best to taste all kinds of noodles.
Because I just don’t get sick of them.
有一点酸的，但是我特别能接受。
It’s a bit sour, but I can totally accept it.
But I can totally accept it.
Wow, so spicy! Is this “mildly spicy”?
酸笋在你最讨厌的排行榜排第几啊？
Where do pickled bamboo shoots rank on your most-hated list?
酸笋在你最讨厌的排行榜排第几啊？
Where do pickled bamboo shoots rank on your most-hated list?
to question life (internet slang: something is shocking)
I heard the first bite makes you question life.
第三口就是完了，上瘾了。
By the third bite it’s over: you’re hooked.
有一说一啊，我刚才上厕所了。
To be honest, I just went to the toilet.
唯一的缺点就是这个牛巴。
The only drawback is this dried beef.

patterns.note: 先说别人怎么说，再用自己的体验回应。这条视频常用这个办法制造看点。
patterns.note_en: First say what others say, then answer with your own experience. The video often builds interest this way.

patterns.note: 推翻听来的说法，语气很强。
patterns.note_en: Overturns what he heard, with a strong tone.

patterns.en: A is not as … as B
patterns.note: 用来比较这几天吃过的粉。
patterns.note_en: Used to compare the noodles from different days.
patterns.ex: 没有生榨粉好吃，但是还可以。
patterns.ex_en: It’s not as tasty as the fresh-pressed noodles, but it’s okay.

patterns.note: 先说一个小缺点，再说好的地方，评价更真实。
patterns.note_en: Name a small drawback first, then the good side: the evaluation sounds more honest.
patterns.ex: 有一点酸的，但是我特别能接受。
patterns.ex_en: It’s a bit sour, but I can totally accept it.
The wider they are, the more I like them.

patterns.note: 说完优点以后，用一个夸张的缺点开个玩笑。
patterns.note_en: After the good points, a joke about one exaggerated drawback.
patterns.ex: 唯一的缺点就是这个牛巴，嗦两分钟，剔两个小时牙。
patterns.ex_en: The only drawback is this dried beef: two minutes of slurping, two hours of picking your teeth.

questions.zh: 这条视频的第一句是什么？
questions.en: What is the first line of this video?
opts: 直接说挑战：一个星期只能嗦粉
He states the challenge: only rice noodles for a week
He greets viewers and introduces himself
questions.why: 和铁蛋的视频不一样，这条视频没有打招呼，第一句就是挑战设定。
questions.why_en: Unlike Tyler’s video, there is no greeting: the first line is the challenge set-up.

questions.zh: 他为什么要挑战一个星期只嗦粉？
questions.en: Why does he take on the one-week noodle challenge?
opts: 因为定居广西，就得嗦粉
Because he lives in Guangxi now, he has to slurp noodles
因为观众留言让他挑战
questions.why: 这是「动机」。铁蛋的动机来自观众的留言，这条视频的动机来自他自己的生活。动机也可以放在挑战设定后面。
questions.why_en: This is the Motivation. Tyler’s came from viewers’ comments; this one comes from his own life. Motivation can also come after the challenge set-up.

questions.zh: 这条视频哪一部分重复了很多次？
questions.en: Which part of the video repeats many times?
opts: 挑战过程和结果：每天吃一种粉，再给一个分数
Challenge process and result: one noodle a day, then a score
questions.why: 一天一轮，一共七轮。铁蛋的视频只试了两轮。美食挑战一般不只尝一种东西。
questions.why_en: One round a day, seven in all. Tyler tested only twice. Food challenges usually try more than one thing.

questions.zh: 观众怎么知道新的一天开始了？
questions.en: How do viewers know a new day has started?
opts: Read: “DAY 1”, “DAY 2”… appears in the top corner
questions.why: 花字「DAY n」标出每一轮的开始，也告诉观众今天吃哪种粉。
questions.why_en: The on-screen text “DAY n” marks the start of each round and names the noodle of the day.

questions.zh: 摊主、店员说话的时候，字幕是什么颜色？
questions.en: When the stall owner or shop staff speak, what colour is the caption?
questions.why: 博主自己的关键词用黄色突出；别人说的话用蓝色或粉色字幕，这样观众知道是谁在说。
questions.why_en: His own key words are highlighted in yellow; other people’s words are in blue or pink captions, so viewers know who is speaking.

questions.zh: 每一轮的结果，除了说「很好吃」「还可以」，还用了什么？
questions.en: Besides saying “very tasty” or “it’s okay”, what else shows each result?
opts: A score on screen, like “9/10” or “7/10”
questions.why: 分数是花字，让结果一眼就看得懂。
questions.why_en: The score is on-screen text, so the result is clear at a glance.

questions.zh: 「我刚才上厕所了」为什么也算结果？
questions.en: Why does “I just went to the toilet” also count as a result?
opts: 这是挑战的后果，回答了标题「外国人受得了吗？」
It is a consequence of the challenge and answers the title “Can a foreigner take it?”
questions.why: 结果不只是打分，也包括挑战对身体的影响，而且他是用自嘲的方式说出来的。
questions.why_en: A result is not only a score; it also includes what the challenge did to his body, told with self-mockery.

questions.zh: 他说「哇好辣」「酸笋最可怕」，这样说中国食物，是不是不礼貌？
questions.en: He says “so spicy” and “pickled bamboo is the scariest”. Is it rude to talk about Chinese food like this?
opts: 是，不能说中国食物不好
Yes, you shouldn’t say Chinese food is bad
不是。在这种挑战视频里，说「可怕」「太酸」是看点，常配上特效和自嘲
No. In this kind of challenge video, “scary” or “too sour” is part of the fun, often with effects and self-mockery
questions.why: 这条视频里好评和差评差不多一样多。负面评价也能逗乐观众，他最后还说「根本就吃不腻」。
questions.why_en: Positive and negative evaluations are about equal in this video. Negative ones entertain too, and in the end he says he never gets sick of them.

questions.zh: 「第一口怀疑人生」是什么意思？
questions.en: What does “the first bite makes you question life” mean?
opts: The first bite is hard to take
The first bite is the best
You want to change jobs after eating
questions.why: 「怀疑人生」是网络用语，表示一件事太让人震惊了。
questions.why_en: “怀疑人生” is internet slang for something shocking.

videos.title: 用100人民币逛德国超市，物价便宜到离谱？
videos.creator: 德国小伙儿吴雨翔
videos.intro: 德国小伙儿吴雨翔用 100 块人民币逛德国超市，看看能买到什么，再一样一样试吃，给中国观众介绍家乡的食物。
videos.intro_en: A German creator shops at a German supermarket with 100 yuan, sees what it buys, then tastes each item and introduces his home food to Chinese viewers.
videos.think: 看的时候想一想：视频开头为什么先放试吃的片段？他怎么让观众觉得东西「很便宜」「很好吃」？
videos.think_en: While you watch, think: why does the video open with tasting clips? How does he make viewers feel things are “cheap” and “tasty”?

lines.zh: 我牙齿都快掉了，它甜到这个程度。
lines.en: My teeth are about to fall out. It’s that sweet.
lines.acte: On-screen “OMG”, crying effect, “555” bullet comments

lines.zh: 世界上最好吃的东西就是这些。
lines.en: The best things in the world are these.

lines.zh: 今天给你们去德国的超市花一百块钱，看一下能买什么呢？
lines.en: Today I’ll go to a German supermarket for you and spend 100 yuan. Let’s see what I can buy.
lines.acte: Holding a 100-yuan note

lines.zh: 100块钱要先汇到欧元，所以14欧。
lines.en: The 100 yuan has to be changed into euros first, so 14 euros.
lines.acte: Raises his index finger to stress “14 euros”

lines.zh: 这边有德国的蛋糕，但是这个太贵了。
lines.en: Here’s German cake, but this is too expensive.
lines.acte: On-screen text “太贵了”

lines.zh: 这个是我家乡的一个特色，只有在这边有啊。
lines.en: This is a specialty of my hometown. You can only get it here.

lines.zh: 能猜得出来这个是什么呢？
lines.en: Can you guess what this is?
lines.acte: “？？？” appears on screen

lines.zh: 德国人最爱的是他们面包上面的黄油，所以黄油不能缺。
lines.en: What Germans love most is the butter on their bread, so butter is a must.
lines.acte: Gestures at a whole row of butter

lines.zh: 这边有各种样的芝士，但这个我们就不买，太贵了，不然的话我们就超标了。
lines.en: There are all kinds of cheese here, but we won’t buy it. Too expensive, otherwise we’d go over budget.
lines.acte: On-screen text “得省着点儿花”

lines.zh: 我们在德国是一个爱吃酸奶的一个大国。
lines.en: In Germany we are a big yogurt-loving nation.
lines.acte: “爱吃” said with stress; on-screen text “买买买”

lines.zh: 德国是巧克力天堂，所以这边所有的巧克力又大又便宜。
lines.en: Germany is a chocolate paradise, so all the chocolate here is big and cheap.

lines.zh: 我们现在到家了。我们花了11点多一丢丢欧，换成人民币的话86人民币。
lines.en: We’re home now. We spent a tiny bit over 11 euros: 86 yuan in RMB.

lines.zh: 两欧，跟我的小手臂一样大。
lines.en: Two euros, and as big as my forearm.
lines.act: 「两欧」读得很重；花字「真的很大！！！」
lines.acte: “两欧” stressed; on-screen text “真的很大！！！”

lines.zh: 但这个会容易腻，我的牙齿都快掉了。
lines.en: But this gets cloying easily. My teeth are about to fall out.
lines.acte: On-screen “OMG!”, crying effect

lines.zh: 第二个是我从小特别喜欢的……Maxiking！
lines.en: The second one is something I’ve loved since I was little… Maxiking!
lines.act: 唱出来「哒哒哒」，背后有粉色爱心
lines.acte: Sings “da da da”, pink hearts behind him

lines.zh: 对我来说童年回忆，没有比这个更好吃的。
lines.en: For me it’s a childhood memory. Nothing tastes better than this.

lines.zh: 但是没有水果的那个味道。
lines.en: But it doesn’t have a fruit flavor.
lines.acte: Caption “不是水果味儿哦”

lines.zh: 一旦它从地板……从锅底piu～飘在上面的话，你知道它好了。
lines.en: Once it floats up from the floor… from the bottom of the pot, piu~, you know it’s done.
lines.act: 说错了：花字「嘴瓢了」，大锤子打头的特效
lines.acte: A slip of the tongue: on-screen “嘴瓢了”, a big hammer hits his head

lines.zh: 你现在肯定在问为什么它叫血肠，因为它是猪的血做出来。
lines.en: You’re surely asking why it’s called blood sausage. Because it’s made from pig’s blood.
lines.acte: Sound effect: a pig squealing

lines.zh: 那个油在你整个嘴巴里面，特别好吃。
lines.en: That fat fills your whole mouth. So delicious.
lines.acte: On-screen text “真香”

lines.zh: 德国有什么东西不能放在面包上吗？不，everything is放在面包上。
lines.en: Is there anything in Germany you can’t put on bread? No, everything goes on bread.
lines.act: 字幕「所有的一切都可以放在面包上」
lines.acte: Caption “所有的一切都可以放在面包上”

lines.zh: 啊，巨咸。
lines.en: Ah, super salty.

lines.zh: 浓郁的樱桃的口味，加上非常奶奶的软软的大米的味道。
lines.en: A rich cherry flavor, plus a very milky, soft rice taste.
lines.acte: Tastes with his eyes closed

lines.zh: 我们今天花了100人民币，在超市里面买了我觉得最奇葩的或者最典型的德国的东西。
lines.en: Today we spent 100 yuan and bought what I think are the weirdest or most typical German things in the supermarket.
lines.act: 两个「最」都读得很重，后面停顿
lines.acte: Both “最” stressed, each followed by a pause

lines.zh: 如果你们很喜欢的话记得评论。OK溜了，mua，拜拜！
lines.en: If you like it, remember to comment. OK, I’m off. Mwah, bye-bye!

words: 今天给你们去德国的超市花一百块钱。
Today I’ll go to a German supermarket for you and spend 100 yuan.
The 100 yuan has to be changed into euros first.
这个是我家乡的一个特色。
This is a specialty of my hometown.
这个是我家乡的一个特色。
This is a specialty of my hometown.
There are all kinds of cheese here.
不然的话我们就超标了。
我们在德国是一个爱吃酸奶的一个大国。
In Germany we are a big yogurt-loving nation.
这边所有的巧克力又大又便宜。
All the chocolate here is big and cheap.
For me it’s a childhood memory.
For me it’s a childhood memory.
你现在肯定在问为什么它叫血肠。
You’re surely asking why it’s called blood sausage.
我觉得最奇葩的或者最典型的德国的东西。
What I think are the weirdest or most typical German things.

patterns.note: 用身边的东西比较，让观众一下子明白有多大。
patterns.note_en: Compares with something familiar, so viewers instantly see how big it is.

patterns.note: 很强的正面评价。预告里也用了这句，吸引观众看下去。
patterns.note_en: A very strong positive evaluation. The preview reuses it to make viewers keep watching.

patterns.ex: 这边所有的巧克力又大又便宜。
patterns.ex_en: All the chocolate here is big and cheap.

patterns.note: 说明为什么不买：要守住 100 块的预算。
patterns.note_en: Explains why he doesn’t buy it: to stay within the 100-yuan budget.
patterns.ex: 太贵了，不然的话我们就超标了。
patterns.ex_en: Too expensive, otherwise we’d go over budget.

patterns.note: 向观众提问，像在和观众聊天。
patterns.note_en: Asks viewers a question, as if chatting with them.
patterns.ex: 能猜得出来这个是什么呢？
patterns.ex_en: Can you guess what this is?

questions.zh: 视频一开头放的是什么？
questions.en: What does the video open with?
opts: 后面试吃时最夸张的片段：「牙齿都快掉了」
The most dramatic tasting clips from later: “my teeth are about to fall out”
questions.why: 这叫「预告」：先放最精彩的评价，吸引观众看下去。铁蛋和嗦粉的视频都没有这个阶段。
questions.why_en: This is a Preview: the most striking evaluations come first to make viewers keep watching. Neither Tyler’s nor the noodle video has this stage.

questions.zh: 这次的挑战是什么？
questions.en: What is the challenge this time?
opts: 用 100 块人民币在德国超市买东西
Shop at a German supermarket with 100 yuan
Eat only German food for a week
questions.why: 挑战设定说得很清楚：花一百块钱，看一下能买什么。
questions.why_en: The set-up says it clearly: spend 100 yuan and see what it buys.

questions.zh: 这条视频的结果有哪两方面？
questions.en: What two kinds of result does this video have?
opts: 钱有没有超过 100 块（花了 86 块），还有买的东西好不好吃
Whether he stayed within 100 yuan (he spent 86), and whether the food tastes good
questions.why: 限定金额的挑战，结果有两面。每样东西试吃一次，就有一个小结果，所以「过程和结果」重复了很多次。
questions.why_en: A budget challenge has two kinds of result. Each tasting gives a small result, so “process and result” repeats many times.

questions.zh: 和嗦粉的视频比，这位博主有什么不同？
questions.en: Compared with the noodle video, how is this creator different?
opts: He evaluates together with his family
他一个人对观众说话，像导游一样介绍自己国家的食物
He talks to viewers alone, like a guide introducing his own country’s food
He keeps chatting with shop staff
questions.why: 嗦粉的博主是在中国学着吃粉的人，常向本地人提问；这位博主是自己国家食物的「内行」，从头到尾都在对观众说。
questions.why_en: The noodle creator is learning local food in China and often asks locals; this creator is an insider to his own food and speaks to viewers the whole time.

questions.zh: 「我们在德国是一个爱吃酸奶的大国」，他怎么突出「爱吃」？
questions.en: How does he stress “爱吃” (love to eat)?
opts: Read: “爱吃” is in a yellow caption
Hear: he says “爱吃” with heavy stress
questions.why: 这条视频常用重音突出关键词，比如「爱吃」「两欧」「最」。
questions.why_en: This video often uses stress for key words, like “爱吃”, “两欧” and “最”.

questions.zh: 他说错话的时候，观众怎么知道这是个玩笑？
questions.en: When he misspeaks, how do viewers know it’s a joke?
opts: 读到和看到：花字「嘴瓢了」，还有大锤子打头的特效
Read and see: on-screen “嘴瓢了” and a hammer hitting his head
听到：他自己说「我说错了」
questions.why: 说错话本来是小失误，后期用花字和特效把它变成了笑点。
questions.why_en: A slip of the tongue becomes a joke through on-screen text and an effect added in editing.

questions.zh: 「不然的话我们就超标了」里，「超标」是什么意思？
questions.en: In this line, what does “超标” mean?
questions.why: 挑战限定了 100 块，买太贵的东西就会超过这个标准。
questions.why_en: The challenge limits him to 100 yuan; buying something expensive would go over that limit.

questions.zh: 最后一句「如果你们很喜欢的话记得评论」属于哪一部分？
questions.en: Which part is the last line “If you like it, remember to comment”?
questions.why: 结尾邀请观众评论。铁蛋的视频没有结尾，嗦粉的视频结尾说「关注我」。
questions.why_en: The closing invites comments. Tyler’s video has no closing; the noodle video ends with “Follow me”.
